description: Which Jira of its own a project is connected to: the site, the account whose token it uses (what a write there is signed as), whether a token is held ('secretSet' — the token itself never comes back) and whether the connection is switched on; and under 'confluence', whether the same site's Confluence is read too, whose account answered there, and whether it has a token of its own ('ownToken') rather than the Jira one. 'connected' false means none. 'canConfigure' says whether you may change it: connecting, or giving a new token, is done on the board's Jira sheet at 'url', since the token is a secret that is never typed in this chat; switching it on or off is set_jira_connection. Any member of the project may ask.
name: get_jira_connection
